gearSetCorrections.chestTalent: Flashpoint: Chance to apply Burn increases from 40% to 60%.
gearSetCorrections.backpackTalent: White Hot: Increases duration of the Burn Damage debuff by +50%.
gearSetCorrections.notes: Red Horizon addition. Core attribute presumed yellow [?]. PvE only (PvP heavily reduced).

namedGearAdditions.name: Trick Shot
namedGearAdditions.talentDesc: Killing an enemy adds 1 round of a random special ammo to your sidearm. Cooldown: 8s.

namedGearAdditions.name: Rushdown
namedGearAdditions.talentDesc: The last enemy damaged by a skill is marked. Dealing weapon damage to that enemy consumes the mark and reduces active skill cooldowns by 12s. Cooldown: 4s.

namedGearAdditions.name: Melon Baller
namedGearAdditions.talentDesc: Headshots increase total weapon damage by 20% for 1.5s (5s with Marksman Rifles). Headshot kills increase total weapon damage by 15% for 10s.

namedGearAdditions.name: Keeper
namedGearAdditions.talentDesc: When your shield is damaged, gain +25% of your armor as bonus armor, and all other allies gain +35% of your armor as bonus armor for 3s. Cooldown: 3s.

exoticGearAdditions.name: Iron Will
exoticGearAdditions.talentDesc: Your next body shot counts as a headshot. PvE cooldown 2s, PvP cooldown 3s. Requires MMR, Rifle, or Pistol equipped.

exoticWeaponAdditions.talentOrPerk: Dragon's Breath: Fires Dragon's Breath shells. Each shot has a 40% chance of applying Burn. Weapon Damage is amplified by 50% of your Status Effect bonus.

Optics: +15% Critical Hit Chance

talentCorrections.name: Determined
talentCorrections.oldValue: Landing a headshot kill grants a guaranteed headshot on your next shot, chaining endlessly on headshot kills.
talentCorrections.newValue: Landing a headshot kill grants a guaranteed headshot on your next hit. Converted headshots no longer chain guaranteed headshots (functions like old Perfect Determined).
talentCorrections.reason: Y8S3 Determined rework: chaining moved to Iron Will's Resolved talent

weaponBuffs.name: Steel & Sons ACR
weaponBuffs.changes: Base stability increased. Max stacks increased from 3 to 4. Destroying a weak point now grants +30% amplified damage for 5s (was 10%).

seasonalModifiers.name: Under Pressure
seasonalModifiers.description: Pressure Gauge builds from kills, headshots, multikills, skill kills, status effect kills, fire kills, and group members' kills.

activeModifiers.name: Fiery Aura
activeModifiers.effect: Increased armor regen and damage resistance, extra protection sprinting, sets nearby enemies alight on entry.

activeModifiers.name: Vicarious Combustion
activeModifiers.effect: Headshots on burning enemies spread Burn nearby; at max gauge headshots apply Burn directly.

activeModifiers.name: Signed, Shield, Delivered
activeModifiers.effect: Improves signature weapon, shield health and regen; kills refill mag without consuming reserve.

hostileModifiers.name: Achilles' Heal
hostileModifiers.effect: Heals enemy and allies when breaking weak points/armor, cuts Pressure.

hostileModifiers.name: Thousand Cuts
